Name: Clint Shop Overhaul (1.6 compatible)
Author: TaisceRayne
Description:
[size=3]A 1.6 compatible version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/49910956]logandoidao[/url][/size][size=3]﻿'s [/size][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10529]Clint Shop Overhaul[/url][/size][size=3]﻿, with a few additional items and the ores repriced to match the prices of the items. All prices were calculated based on the cost of materials to create them, but they're all fully editable in the Generic Mod Config Menu.
[/size]
